what_i_found: Your strongest shot is the one coming home: cast harmlessly past porcelain creatures, steer your salvage boat, then recall to reshape the returning harpoon's path through the shoal. Missed creatures circle back with their remaining health, so each of five voyages ends only when you resolve its encounters. Moving the boat becomes a way to aim, inside a drowned ceramic garden with reflected cobalt paintings and original chapter music.
